faqs.q: What is included in the build price, and what costs extra?
faqs.a: The build price covers design, development, SEO foundations, analytics setup and training, exactly as listed in each tier. Your domain name and hosting are billed at cost and registered in your name, so you always own them. Photography and videography are not included; we can work with your existing images, licensed stock, or a photographer you engage locally.

We scope your build in a short call, then give you a fixed written quote for that exact scope. You see the number before you commit to anything, and it does not move unless the scope does. SEO is different: those plans have published monthly pricing, from AUD $990 a month, month to month with no lock-in.

faqs.q: Is there a contract or lock-in?
faqs.a: No. Website builds are a fixed-price project with a deposit and a final payment at launch. SEO plans run month to month and you can stop at the end of any month. Everything we produce, including the code, the content and the accounts, belongs to you.

faqs.q: How long does a website build take?
faqs.a: A Launch site typically takes three to four weeks from kick-off. Business builds usually run five to eight weeks depending on page count and copy. Platform projects are scoped individually, so the timeline is confirmed before work starts. The biggest variable is how quickly content and feedback come back from your side, and we flag that plainly in the project plan.

faqs.q: Can we start with an SEO plan on our existing website?
faqs.a: Yes. All three SEO plans work on sites we did not build. We start with a technical audit in the first month, fix what is holding the site back, and tell you honestly if the site itself is the bottleneck. Some clients start with SEO and rebuild later; there is no requirement to do both with us.

No, all prices on this page exclude GST. GST is added to invoices at the standard 10 per cent for Australian customers. Every invoice is itemised, and there are no charges beyond what you have agreed to in writing.
